headwords: cẩn tắc vô ưu, vô áy náy

flags.why: The example defines an imperative sentence instead of showing the adjective in use.
flags.fix: Cô giáo yêu cầu mỗi học sinh viết hai câu cầu khiến. = The teacher asked each student to write two imperative sentences.

flags.why: The example explains what cocci are instead of using the word in context.
flags.fix: Mẫu bệnh phẩm có chứa cầu khuẩn. = The specimen contains cocci.

flags.why: The example defines the pons instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Khối u nằm ở cầu não. = The tumour is located in the pons.

flags.why: The phrase expresses a wish through a fruit-name pun rather than naming the act of offering fruit, as illustrated by [Tuổi Trẻ](https://tuoitre.vn/cach-lam-mut-sung-cho-mot-nam-cau-sung-vua-du-xai-20191215150826525.htm).
flags.fix: a Tết wish for prosperity and enough to spend, expressed through a pun on five fruit names

flags.why: Cầu tuột is mainly Southern usage and needs a regional label.

Cẩn cáo means respectfully announcing or submitting something, often as a ritual closing formula, rather than simply 'respectfully', according to [Ngày ngày viết chữ](https://ngayngayvietchu.com/giai-nghia-tu-han-viet-trong-tieng-viet-phan-1/).
flags.fix: respectfully submitted (a closing formula in ritual prayers or funeral addresses)

flags.why: The example mentions the formula instead of demonstrating its use.
flags.fix: Nay kính dâng lễ vật, cúi xin chứng giám. Cẩn cáo. = We now respectfully present these offerings and humbly ask you to bear witness. Respectfully submitted.

flags.why: The example explains a grammatical classification instead of showing the word in use.
flags.fix: Thầy yêu cầu chúng tôi tìm năm động từ cập vật trong đoạn văn. = The teacher asked us to find five transitive verbs in the passage.

flags.why: The euphemism applies to adult men as well as boys, as reflected in [Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/cậu_nhỏ).
The example explains the historical title instead of using it to refer to someone.
flags.fix: Cậu ấm được hai người hầu đưa đến trường. = The mandarin's son was escorted to school by two servants.
